title: reconciled.json: cited drafts combined with recorded Lt evidence

proposed_selection.description: For multiple-choice, option_ids supported by reasoning in segments. Reading panelState.modelAnswer is permitted and on by default. `model_answer.read` (default true) can disable it. Drafted selections still require reasoning and provenance tags. Copying the key would evaluate the suite against the key instead of its research.

label_placements.description: Required in schema_version 2 for drafted image-labeling, drag-and-drop-labeling and categorization items. Records where each label goes, as table_cells records grid answers. Describe the target in prose. Capture emits no anchor coordinates, and option_id refers to a position in an alphabetically sorted pool. Describe anchors so a fill run can resolve them against the picture.

label.description: Label text verbatim from the item's options[].text. The cross-check rejects other text to prevent invented vocabulary.

target.description: Where the label goes. For the two labelling types, describe an anchor so a human or fill run can find it, e.g. 'the upper-left circle'. For categorization, use the bin title verbatim from constraints.categories. There is no category_titles field.

target_index.description: Only where the index is genuinely knowable from the capture - a categorization bin's position in constraints.categories, which is emitted in the order the student sees it and is therefore knowable. NEVER guess one for an image anchor.

confidence.description: Confidence per placement. medium or low requires `alternative`, enforced by the validator (ltcore.validate). See docs/design-notes.md for confidence limits.

alternative.description: The competing reading: the structure this label might sit on instead. Named, not gestured at.

ref.description: Local id referenced by segments, e.g. 'p1'.

source_id.description: Tier 4 MUST be a resolvable DOI (10.x/…) or PMID:<digits>. An unresolvable identifier is a fabrication and is deleted, not softened.

tag.description: Rendered provenance tag, e.g. [T1:lecture-1:slide-14]. Derived from the authoritative structured fields.

tier_descent.description: Record a reason for descending each tier. Reaching tier 3 requires accounts of tiers 1 and 2. Validated for completeness.

conflicts.description: Surface conflicts without silently reconciling them. Renders as ⚠ Conflict in the export.
